snippet.title: The Cursed Frog | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #thecursedfrog

🐸The Cursed Frog Launch Trailer 🐸
👸 Available for Nintendo Switch, Playstation, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Microsoft Store!

The Cursed Frog is a single-player puzzle-platformer where you combine logic and reflexes to activate magic bridges, manipulate platforms, and discover secret routes in this ever-changing enchanted world. Each level brings new challenges that test your creativity and strategy.

KEY FEATURES:
🐸 Form-Switching Gameplay;
🐸 Day-Night Mechanics;
🐸 30 Magical Levels;
🐸 Enchanted Platforming;

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
👸 Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-cursed-frog-switch/
👸 Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015751
👸 Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/the-cursed-frog/9npthlnvqdvs
👸 Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/the-cursed-frog-xbox-one/9nd6nfv4q6k0
👸 Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/the-cursed-frog-windows/9npdr90qmshw
